description: One-call HUMAN EVALUATION launch: creates a job draft plus a linked eval project where vetted human graders blind-grade your model outputs. mode is PAIRWISE (default; exactly 2 experiments, A/B battle), SINGLE (1 experiment, rubric grading), RANKING (2-8 experiments), or TRAJECTORY (exactly 1 experiment; graders review full agent conversations step by step). Each experiment is one model run: {label, modelId?, rows:[{itemKey?, prompt, output}]} — rows pair across experiments by itemKey and graders never see which model produced which output. TRAJECTORY experiments carry trajectories:[{itemKey?, messages:[...]}] INSTEAD of rows/sampleFrom — each entry is one agent run as an OpenAI-style message list (roles system|developer|user|assistant|tool; assistant tool_calls and tool-result messages expand into positional, reviewable steps). Optional project.gates are release rules ({key, metricKey, operator, threshold, requireCI?}) evaluated with bootstrap confidence intervals. Optional budgetUsd validates against prepaid credits (402 = top up first; money still moves only at hire through escrow). Returns jobId, projectId, import counts, and next steps. platformExport {format?, content} imports a LangSmith/Braintrust/Weave/Phoenix export directly (XOR with experiments; mode inferred when omitted). project.template selects a grading template/config preset by id (SINGLE presets: eval-rubric-engineering — the worker AUTHORS a per-item rubric; eval-verifier-authoring — the worker writes and runs checkable verification steps; eval-deep-research-grading — sourcing/citation/coverage/synthesis grading); unknown or wrong-mode ids refuse with the valid ids and the response reports the template applied. Requires jobs:write + open-label:write scopes.

sampleFrom.description: OpenTrain samples YOUR endpoint server-side — XOR with rows

trainingRunId.description: Link to a TrainingRun (rails or external — Step 19-ext)

trajectories.description: TRAJECTORY mode only (exactly 1 experiment): agent conversations to review — replaces rows/sampleFrom

messages.description: One agent run as an OpenAI-style message list — assistant tool calls and tool results expand into positional, reviewable steps

tool_call_id.description: On role:tool results — links back to the assistant tool call

tool_calls.description: Assistant-only tool invocations: [{id?, function?: {name, arguments}} | {name, arguments}]

platformExport.description: U94: import an observability-platform export directly (LangSmith/Braintrust/Weave/Phoenix; format auto-detected when omitted) — XOR with experiments. Chat/agent runs become TRAJECTORY items, plain prompt/output runs become SINGLE rows; a mixed export refuses unless mode picks one. The response carries a platformImport summary.

content.description: The exported JSON value, or a JSON/JSONL document string

name: opentrain_launch_eval_work
